claims.evidence: KDIGO table (UK mg/mmol units): A1 <3 normal to mildly increased, A2 3-30 moderately increased, A3 >30 severely increased; NICE NG203 uses these categories for staging.

North Bristol NHS Trust document retrieved: PCR >300 mg/mmol nephrotic-range proteinuria (and ACR >250 mg/mmol). UK source also gives PCR >300 equals about 3.5 g/24 h; some sources use 350 (StatPearls, review), hence 'some NHS laboratory guidance' is appropriately hedged. It is truly a PCR.
NICE: CKD classified by eGFR and ACR; UKKA SGLT2i guideline and draft NG203 use ACR thresholds for medicines, so general wording is supported and not overstated.

NICE NG203 (re-retrieved): ACR 3 to 70 mg/mmol - confirm in a subsequent early-morning sample; no repeat if ACR >=70. UKKA quick reference listed in results but not excerpted; NICE is the clearer carrier.

KDIGO: abnormalities for a minimum of 3 months; NICE: >3 months / GFR measurements >=90 days apart; UK eCKD guide uses 3 months. 'more than three months' matches NICE wording; KDIGO says at least 3 months, so a purist would write 'three months or more' (cosmetic).
NICE NG203: a confirmed ACR of 3 mg/mmol or more is clinically important proteinuria; KDIGO 30 mg/g (~3 mg/mmol) threshold for albuminuria.
KDIGO table A1 <3 mg/mmol; NICE adopts. UK label correct (mg/mmol).
NICE NG203: confirmed ACR >=3 mg/mmol is clinically important proteinuria.

NICE NG203 (retrieved): ACR 3 to 70 repeat in early-morning sample; not needed at 70 or more. The cited UKKA PDF appeared in results but its text was not excerpted; consider adding NICE as source. Note some local pathways say 'above 70'.
NBT: PCR >300 nephrotic range, ACR >250; others 350 (StatPearls/review) - context hedges correctly. Is a PCR, not ACR. UK label ok for NHS trust document.

KDIGO 2024: abnormalities of kidney structure or function present for a minimum of 3 months; UK eCKD guide same; NICE >3 months/90 days. GLOBAL label right. Value 'More than 3 months' is NICE-style; KDIGO phrase is 'minimum of 3 months'.

notes: No mandatory change. Optional: r05 add NICE NG203 as source (retrieved text is NICE's); r07/c05 may say '3 months or more' to match KDIGO. Nephrotic range: PCR >300 mg/mmol confirmed as PCR (NBT) with ACR >250 equivalent; 350 variant also retrievable. ACR persistent >=3 and 3-70 rule verified. Kidney-protecting medicines wording: NICE draft/UKKA tie ACR to ACE-i/ARB (>=70) and SGLT2i thresholds, so a specific threshold stays out; general phrase fine.
